message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Pylint

on: [workflow_dispatch]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.14"]
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v7
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pylint
    - name: Analysing the code with pylint
      run: |
        pylint $(find influxdb_client_3 -name '*.py')",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads pip dependencies (pylint) on every run with no cache. The repository has pyproject.toml, which can serve as a cache input key. Evidence from the measured fork experiment (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / P-LIT-GHA-CACHE family) shows adding a pip cache keyed on dependency files reduced median elapsed CI time by about 9.2% while preserving the same install and test steps. Adding actions/cache@v4 before dependency installation preserves the intended pylint analysis coverage, requires no new secrets, privileged actions, deployment, or network access beyond the existing pip install, and is a minimal change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
